## A natural way for cells to die

Cells also have natural ways of dying. **Programmed Cell Death (PCD)** is a genetically regulated and organised process of selective cell destruction. It is essential for normal development, cellular quality control and immune function.

<!-- STEP -->
## How fingers form

When an embryo develops, PCD helps form the fingers by eliminating the cells between the digits. Without it, we would have webbed hands.

**Removing cells can build a shape, just as adding cells can.**
